name: Virtual patients (PBPK dosing)
summary: A whole-body physiologically based pharmacokinetic model of a drug in thousands of virtual patients: a trial of a dosing regimen, the best dose per population, and one patient followed live in 3D

inputs.label: CT case
inputs.help: Make the 3D models: a CT case with its labels (ct.nii.gz and segmentations/<structure>.nii.gz, as the TotalSegmentator dataset gives them). Without it, the patient is a mockup.
